blurb: Step into Nashville’s most glamorous Prohibition adventure — the only all-inclusive vintage cocktail tour in town! Skip the crowded pub crawls and join a select group of just 8 guests for a swanky 3-hour tasting of expertly crafted Jazz Age cocktails, paired with chef-curated bites. Sip in style at three of the city’s top hidden venues — including authentic speakeasies — as your charismatic host serves up jaw-dropping true tales of Al Capone, bootleggers, and the roaring underground. This is history you can drink to: rich stories, refined flavors, and the kind of night you’ll be talking and laughing about long after the last toast!
